comparison_policy.primary: Compare only the same periodic graph and raw variational energies at equal Hamiltonian normalization.

recent_infinite_system_context.result: Symmetry-constrained iPEPS finds the magnetic-order collapse near J2/J1 about 0.08; a fully symmetric Z2 RVB PEPS at D=3 already has a reasonably good variational energy, while optimizing generic Z2 PEPS through D=7 condenses spinons and confines visons, favoring a gapless or critical interpretation.
recent_infinite_system_context.comparison_warning: This is thermodynamic-limit physics context, not a same-torus 6x6 energy target.
